title: Portrait and Winter
author: Cyrus Underhill
blurb: Quentin Winterbourne, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
